g.text: Settings (for sudo and system password pop-ups)
Fingerprint checks happen when sudo or a system pop-up asks for your password. Your password
always still works. The login screen and lock screen are not affected.
Apply runs the orange command on the left. The screen
switches to the normal terminal so sudo can ask for your
Settings are kept in /etc/goodix550c/pam.conf and survive
What happens when you type sudo
Each touch waits up to 20 s. A match lets you in at once; after 4 misses or 80 s at most, it
Looks fine: the current values suit how you use it.
